title: 3D Model Ingestion, OBJ/MTL Parsing & Mesh Pipeline Architecture

blocks.content: Engineering notebook from `docs/OBJ_LOADER_AND_3D_MODEL_PIPELINE_ARCHITECTURE.md`. This archive preserves the project’s original rationale, equations, performance reports and illustrative code. Historical paths, API names, claims and sketches can differ from the current engine. For copy-ready programs use the guides and demos; for current callable signatures use the source-derived API. Performance figures here describe reported experiments, not guaranteed frame rates.

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/OBJ_LOADER_AND_3D_MODEL_PIPELINE_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/OBJ_LOADER_AND_3D_MODEL_PIPELINE_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

Rendering real-world objects, mathematical CAD surfaces, and 3D scientific meshes requires an asynchronous model ingestion pipeline capable of parsing polygonal geometry, material definitions, and texture maps.

items: **[`OBJLoader`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/utils/OBJLoader.ts)**: High-speed asynchronous parser for Wavefront OBJ geometry and companion MTL material libraries.
**[`Model`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/3d/Model.ts)**: Core 3D renderable entity wrapping geometric vertex buffers and surface materials.

**[`ModelGeometry`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/geometry/ModelGeometry.ts) & [`ModelRenderer`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/renderers/ModelRenderer.ts)**: Component-level abstractions managing GPU Vertex/Index Buffer Objects (VBO/IBO) and pipeline bind groups.

blocks.code:
flowchart TD OBJ["Wavefront .OBJ file"] --> MTL["MTL library
.mtl parsing"] OBJ --> GEO["Geometry pass
v, vn, vt, f"] MTL --> MAPS["Diffuse, specular and normal maps
Roughness and metallic maps"] GEO --> TRI["N-gon triangulation"] TRI --> NORMAL["Topology normal generator
Smooth or flat shading"] MAPS --> GROUP["Group partitioning
Single Model or Entity tree"] NORMAL --> GROUP GROUP --> GPU["WebGPU ModelGeometry and VBO"]

blocks.text: The parser iterates through lines using optimized string slicing:

items: **`v x y z`**: Geometric vertex coordinates.
**`vt u v`**: Texture UV coordinates (flipped vertically $v' = 1 - v$ to match WebGPU top-left texture coordinates).
**`vn x y z`**: Analytical vertex normal vectors.
**`f v1/vt1/vn1 v2/vt2/vn2 ...`**: Face definitions. Quad and n-gon faces are decomposed into triangle fans using fan triangulation $(v_0, v_i, v_{i+1})$.

blocks.text: B. Flat vs. Smooth Topology Calculation

items: **Smooth Shading (`topology: 'smooth'`)**: If vertex normals are missing, Retiam computes area-weighted vertex normals by accumulating face cross products:

blocks.text: Sharing vertices across triangles produces continuous Blinn-Phong and PBR shading.

items: **Flat Shading (`topology: 'flat'`)**: Handled via [`Math3D.computeFlatShading()`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/math/Math3D.ts). Vertex buffers are completely de-indexed (each triangle gets 3 distinct vertices). The unweighted face normal is duplicated across all 3 vertices, producing crisp faceted low-poly visuals.

blocks.text: When `loadMtl: true` is configured, companion `.mtl` files are fetched and converted into Retiam [`Material`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Material.ts) instances:

cells.text: Asynchronously uploaded to GPU texture array

blocks.text: When `legacyMaterials: true` is active, models with high specular exponents ($N_s > 50$) are automatically promoted to metallic PBR materials.

items: **Single Group**: If the OBJ file contains only one material group, `OBJLoader.load()` returns a direct [`Model`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/3d/Model.ts) instance.

**Multi-Group**: If the OBJ file defines multiple sub-meshes or materials via `o`, `g`, or `usemtl`, `OBJLoader.load()` returns an [`Entity`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Entity.ts) root node whose children are individual `Model` instances sharing parent transformations.
